about: Frankendom parts, stage 1 (Dom 2026-10-28: 'you become what you kill'). Cutting a fallen boss (tap, as before; no Take button) adds that part to the player's inventory automatically: the corpse:cut event names the boss's data/profiles.json id and the unit; the part is `<profile id>:<slot id>`. A part keeps the HIGHEST star level it was ever cut at (data/stars.json levels: 0, 1, 2), which is its rarity (`rarities`) and, for star 1 and 2, its trophy tag (the star level's trophy name). `slots`: the places on the hero; `units` are the physics cut units that fill them (head, arm_left, arm_right, leg_left, leg_right, torso_waist); the weapon slot has none (it shows the boss-weapon reward of data/progression.json and is not equipped here). One equipped part per slot; equip and unequip are one tap each. The inventory and the equipped map ride in the data/progression.json save as optional fields (`parts`, `equipped`), so a save from before them loads with both empty. `maxCount`: the cap on how many times one part is counted. Stage 1 is the inventory and the menu only: nothing is drawn on the hero yet (stage 2). `button` / `panel`: the ☰ button and the sheet it opens (DOM only, pointer-events on the button and sheet, the palette is the V1 journal's). `text`: every word the menu shows. Values are checked by src/parts.ts validateParts at load; keys by src/sim/validate.js.

text.title: Frankendom
text.hint: Cut a fallen boss to keep a part. Equip one per slot.
